# Night Glider

Night Glider is the adventurous blue Pegasus from Starlight Glimmer's Our Town in G4 *Friendship is Magic*. Alongside Sugar Belle, Party Favor and Double Diamond, she helps overthrow Starlight's enforced sameness. Think of her as the group's airborne scout and a pony who rediscovers the value of her own talent.

[![Night Glider flying ahead of the balloon bridge — Hasbro Studios / DHX Media, S5E2](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/19/1498402__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_double%2Bdiamond_night%2Bglider_party%2Bfavor_sugar%2Bbelle_earth%2Bpony_pegasus_pony_unicorn_the%2Bcutie%2Bmap_balloon_bal.png)](https://twibooru.org/1498402)

- **Appearance:** Deep blue coat, bright blue eyes, swept-back white and pale blue-gray mane and tail, and a crescent moon framed by two curved feathers as her cutie mark. Under Starlight, her colors are muted and her mark is an equals sign.
- **Name and voice:** Night Glider is an official credits name, not a fandom invention; it is not spoken as her name in the series according to the character reference. She is a speaking character voiced in English by Rebecca Shoichet (also Sugar Belle). The [S5E2 credits capture](https://twibooru.org/659420) confirms both. She shares her name and general coloring with a separate [G1 Earth pony](https://www.mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Night_Glider). No secret identity is established.
- **Appearances:** Debuts April 4, 2015 in The Cutie Map (S5E1–2). Returns in The Cutie Re-Mark (S5E26), To Where and Back Again (S6E25–26, with dialogue in Part 1), Celestial Advice (S7E1), Hard to Say Anything (S7E8), The Big Mac Question (S9E23), The Ending of the End (S9E25) and The Last Problem (S9E26, montage). Also appears in the opening of the 2017 movie and Gameloft's mobile game. See the [character and appearance reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Night_Glider).

## Important moments

- **Questioning sameness — The Cutie Map, Part 1 (S5E1):** Her curiosity about how ponies with different cutie marks can be friends exposes the limitations of Starlight's teachings. [Episode](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/the-cutie-map-pt-1/umc.cmc.1kls85gfibcqumlth0hw7w0j9) (timestamp unavailable).
- **Taking back her freedom — The Cutie Map, Part 2 (S5E2):** After regaining her mark, she breaks down Starlight's door and uses her flying skills to help the villagers pursue the stolen cutie marks.
- **Choosing her home — The Cutie Map, Part 2 (S5E2):** She decides to remain in the village with her friends, demonstrating that their community can survive without enforced conformity. [Full episode for both S5E2 scenes](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165262/s05-e02-the-cutie-map-pt-2) (timestamps unavailable).
- **Forgiving Starlight — The Cutie Re-Mark, Part 2 (S5E26):** She joins the villagers in welcoming their former leader back after her redemption. [Full episode](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165237/s05-e26-the-cutie-re-mark-pt-2) (timestamp unavailable).
